src/_data/site.json.description: Global site metadata file for Eleventy templates. Contains: name (Atelier Rita Tomforde), title, description, author, lang (de), and contact object with location details. Available in templates via {{ site.name }}, {{ site.title }}, etc.

src/_includes/base.njk.description: Base Nunjucks layout template for all pages. Contains HTML5 structure with lang="de", meta tags (charset, viewport, description, author), title with site.name fallback, CSS link using | url filter, includes for nav.njk and footer.njk partials, and {{ content | safe }} block for page content.

src/css/styles.css.description: Responsive design implementation uses mobile-first approach with breakpoints at: 480px (gallery 2-col), 768px (tablet - gallery 3-col, row layouts), 1024px (desktop - gallery 4-col, full nav), 1200px (large desktop - wider content). Hamburger menu appears at max-width: 767px. All containers use max-width: 100% with proper padding to prevent horizontal scroll.

.github/workflows/deploy.yml.description: GitHub Actions workflow for automated deployment to GitHub Pages. Triggers on push to main branch or manual workflow_dispatch. Uses actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 (Node 20 with npm cache), npm ci, npm run build with ELEVENTY_ENV=production, and peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3 to publish _site to gh-pages branch.
